dimensions.evidenceA: The Abraham scene names a test that exposes obedience.
dimensions.evidenceB: James denies that God entices people through evil desire.
dimensions.label: Wording and purpose

evidence.observation: After these things, God tested Abraham and said to him, “Abraham!”
A tempted man must not say, “I am tempted by God,” because God can’t be tempted by evil and tempts no one.

record.tension: English test and tempt can overlap, but the two passages describe different claims whose source wording and purpose require inspection.
record.title: Does God test or tempt?
